detail.description: Kitodo.Production 是一种用于大规模数字化的工作流程管理工具，是 Kitodo 数字图书馆套件的一部分。在版本 3.9.2 之前，org.kitodo.production.helper.XMLUtils 公开了几个 XML 解析帮助器，这些解析器使用默认的非安全配置构造 JAXP 解析器。 parseXMLString(String)、getNumberOfEADElements(String, String) 和 checkIfXmlIsWellFormed(String) 方法通过 newInstance() 构建 DocumentBuilderFactory / XMLInputFactory / SAXParserFactory 并解析攻击者提供的字符串，而无需禁用 DOCTYPE 声明或外部实体解析。这些帮助程序直接位于 EAD 导入路径上：通过“创建流程”文件上传对话框上传 EAD/XML 文件的经过身份验证的用户将通过这些方法解析上传的字节。因此，带有外部实体的精心设计的文档会产生 XML 外部实体 (XXE) 注入：本地文件泄露和来自服务器的出站 SSRF 请求。该问题已在 3.9.2 版本中修复。
detail.kind_en: XML外部实体引用限制不当
detail.title: CVE-2026-54668漏洞

detail_original.description: Kitodo.Production is a workflow management tool for mass digitization and is part of the Kitodo Digital Library Suite. Prior to version 3.9.2, org.kitodo.production.helper.XMLUtils exposes several XML parsing helpers that construct a JAXP parser with the default, non-secure configuration. The methods parseXMLString(String), getNumberOfEADElements(String, String) and checkIfXmlIsWellFormed(String) build a DocumentBuilderFactory / XMLInputFactory / SAXParserFactory via newInstance() and parse the attacker-supplied string without disabling DOCTYPE declarations or external entity resolution. These helpers sit directly on the EAD-import path: an authenticated user who uploads an EAD/XML file through the "Create process" file-upload dialog has the uploaded bytes parsed by these methods. A crafted document with an external entity therefore yields XML External Entity (XXE) injection: local file disclosure and outbound SSRF requests from the server. This issue has been patched in version 3.9.2.
detail_original.kind_en: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
detail_original.title: CVE-2026-54668漏洞
